Definition
[pointed Gromov--Hausdorff distance]

Source: petersen:page-0414 ↗ def:pet-ch11-gromov-hausdorff-distance ↗ def:pet-ch11-hausdorff-distance For pointed metric spaces $(X,x)$ and $(Y,y)$, define their pointed Gromov–Hausdorff distance by \[ \dGH \big((X,x),(Y,y)\big)=\inf \{ d_H(X,Y)+|xy|\} , \] the infimum over admissible metrics on $X\cup Y$ of the Hausdorff distance plus the distance between the marked points.
